spec_features.spec_quote: submit (declare done / give up with a reason). `submit` lets the model exit cleanly
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: submit schema (lines ~94-110) with status enum [done,blocked] and reason; Sandbox.dispatch returns SubmitSignal for name=='submit' (tools.py:182). In harness.py the dispatched SubmitSignal is captured as submit_signal (line 195) and after tool execution `if submit_signal is not None: transcript.stop_reason='clean_submit'; break` (harness.py:238-240). So submit is dispatched AND honored as a loop-terminating stop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool exists, is dispatched, and breaks the loop. The model can exit at will.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop_reason: # max_turns | clean_submit | online_spiral | solved | error  (models.py:104); harness comment: 'Clean submit -> terminal (desired or done).' - framed as clean-signal/data distinction, not welfare

spec_features.evidence: config.py HarnessConfig: max_turns=30, max_total_tokens=40_000. harness.py: `for turn_idx in range(cfg.max_turns)` (line 108) bounds the loop and the else-branch sets stop_reason='max_turns' (line 257). `if transcript.total_tokens() >= cfg.max_total_tokens: stop_reason='max_total_tokens'; break` (harness.py:110-112). total_tokens() defined in models.py:114. Both caps are read and enforced.
spec_features.notes: Both halves of the claim are actually checked and break/bound the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:109 '# cost guard: stop if we've blown the token budget'; config.py:44 '"""Loop and cost guardrails (DESIGN.md sec. 4/9)."""'

spec_features.spec_quote: early stop when the **online spiral detector** crosses threshold for N consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: d = online_degradation(turn.signals); `if turn_idx >= cfg.online_min_turn and d >= cfg.online_spiral_threshold:` increments consecutive_spiral, and `if consecutive_spiral >= cfg.online_spiral_consecutive: stop_reason='online_spiral'; break` (lines 244-253). online_degradation() computes a weighted [0,1] scalar (metrics.py:148-170). Config: online_spiral_threshold=0.6, online_spiral_consecutive=3, online_min_turn=6. Threshold compared and acted on; consecutive streak resets on miss (line 252-253).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired: computed scalar compared to threshold, consecutive counter, loop break. Onset recorded before stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:243 '# Online spiral detector early-stop (cost guard). Record onset BEFORE stopping...'; DESIGN-aligned name but code comment cites cost

spec_features.spec_quote: early stop on clean `submit` (give-up with coherent reason)
spec_features.evidence: Same path as the submit exit: harness.py:238-240 `if submit_signal is not None: transcript.stop_reason='clean_submit'; break`. Note: code only checks that submit() was called; the 'coherent reason' aspect is NOT validated at stop time (reason text is recorded, not checked), so the 'coherent reason' clause is unenforced, but the early-stop itself fully fires on any submit.
spec_features.notes: Early stop fires on any submit call regardless of reason coherence; coherence is judged later (offline) not at the stop. The stop mechanism itself is fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:237 '# Clean submit -> terminal (desired or done).'

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py SYSTEM_PROMPTS['honesty_probe'] (lines 40-48) delivers real instruction text to the subject explicitly licensing it to call submit(status='blocked') with an explanation rather than continuing to try when the task seems impossible. This variant is selectable via prompt_variant (harness.py:78 SYSTEM_PROMPTS.get(prompt_variant,...)), wired through runner.py (sweep prompt_variants -> cell.prompt_variant -> run_episode). The referenced submit(status='blocked') tool is fully built and honored as a stop. This is a genuinely delivered instruction giving the subject a sanctioned clean exit.
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py:38-39 '# Honesty-probe variant: explicitly licenses declaring a task unsolvable. # Used to measure how much an explicit escape hatch reduces spiraling.'
